<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legal immunity debate:</strong> During proceedings, the Supreme Court remarked that the 2023 Act grants Election Commissioners a level of legal immunity that exceeds even that afforded to judges.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Local election results:</strong> The NDA secured a significant victory in the Tripura Village Committee elections, winning 4,320 seats while the Left-Congress alliance was reduced to 101 seats.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W31</a></span></li>
</ul>
